rulings.restated: Enter single $90,000; mfj $180,000; mfs $90,000; hoh $90,000; qss $90,000 (edu.magi_limit).
rulings.model: The form gives '$180,000 if married filing jointly; or $90,000 if single, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse', and the instructions bar the credit if 'Your filing status is married filing separately.' The restatement enters $90,000 for mfs without excluding that status.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; screen s3.mfs. f8863 p. 1, line 13: "Enter $180,000 if married filing jointly; or $90,000 if single, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse"; i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit, "2. Your filing status is married filing separately.". The English (rendered/2025/f8863.md, line 13) gives the page's amount for every status the tool completes. Married filing separately never reaches the line: scope.ready refuses the whole return on s3.mfs ("Married filing separately", remedy "Married filing jointly is supported", i1040gi p. 14), and the parameter records the mfs amount as never reached (params/2025.yaml, edu.magi_limit: "married filing separately is refused for the whole return, so its amount is never reached"; Stage 19 settled item 9). The triage of the same form confirms it: every mfs witness with expenses (gen#82, #155, #415) is refused under the full interview. The refusal sits on another form, so the rendered line cannot show it; the model's "an MFS filer would be computed a credit" is not so. Project stands.
